description: The same meal, made from cheaper components, then fewer components, then fewer meals. The adjustment is continuous and invisible from outside the household.
energy_note: The same pot, with less in it, every month.

aspect: Buying small is the expensive way to buy
description: Sachet economics - a cup of rice, a sachet of oil, a hundred naira of recharge. Unit costs are highest for those with the least, which is a poverty premium paid daily.
money_note: Annual poverty premium from small-quantity purchasing.
energy_note: Charged more per gram, for having less cash.

aspect: School fees are the first casualty and the last admitted
description: Fees, uniforms, books and exam registrations are lumpy costs in a month with no slack, and the decision to defer them is made quietly and usually about a daughter first.
energy_note: A term skipped, and nobody outside the house is told.

aspect: The cognitive load is the hidden cost
description: Continuous arithmetic about prices, credit, who is owed, what can wait. It occupies the same attention that would go to work or study, which is the mechanism in PSY-004.
energy_note: A calculator running in your head, all day, for years.

description: In January the stew had beef twice a week. By April it is beef on Sundays. By August it is beef when someone is visiting. Nobody in the house has been told that anything changed, and the children have stopped asking.
energy_note: The same pot, quietly emptier, month by month.

aspect: Managing it well is what conceals it
description: The better she is at absorbing the shortfall, the less anyone else in the household registers that there is one - so competence at this work guarantees that it goes unrecognised, and the recognition is what would get her help.
energy_note: Rewarded for hiding it, and therefore never helped.
